chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah, from al-Fuḍayl ibn Yasār and Zurārah, from one of them عليه السلام, who said:

The woman in nifās refrains from salat (prayer) for the days of her regular menstrual periods during which she used to remain [away from prayer]; then she performs ghusl and acts as the mustaḥāḍah acts.

key_terms.أَيَّامَ أَقْرَائِهَا: the days of her usual menstrual cycle
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual prayer from which she refrains during nifās
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةُ: a woman with irregular non-menstrual bleeding whose legal rulings are then followed

ai.seo_question: How long does a woman in nifās refrain from salat (prayer), and what does she do afterward?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the woman in nifās after childbirth. She leaves salat (prayer) for the number of days corresponding to her usual menstrual period, then performs ghusl and follows the rulings of the mustaḥāḍah.
